title: Lesson 2 Quiz: Using dApps Safely, Step by Step

questions.text: Why should you set a custom token allowance instead of granting unlimited approval?
options: Custom allowance limits the contract's ability to spend tokens beyond intended amount
Unlimited approval is required for all dApps
Custom approval prevents you from connecting your wallet
questions.explanation: The narration warns that unlimited approval lets a contract spend remaining tokens even after you close the tab.

questions.text: True or false: Connecting your wallet to a dApp shares your private key with the dApp.
questions.explanation: The narration says connecting only shares your public address, letting the dApp read your balance.
